prompt: Write API.md at the workspace root documenting the public API of the ledger package. Use one section per module, with the heading `## ledger.<module>` (for example `## ledger.money`), for every module in ledger/ except __init__.py. In each section list every public function and class defined at the top level of that module (names that do not start with an underscore), each with a one-line description of what it does, based on the actual code. Do not change any code.

metadata.summary: Read every module of a ~1,100-line package and document its 62 public names. Hidden check: a section per module, every public name documented, no source changed.
